aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:846.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary The Porter will be responsible for the cleanliness and upkeep of all areas of the venue including the main floor, mezzanine, backstage, bathrooms, bars, etc. The porter is also responsible for basic building upkeep and maintenance including changing lightbulbs, basic light construction tasks, painting, restocking cleaning supplies, and more as needed. Essential Functions Post event cleaning: follow procedures and cleaning routines as scheduled for sweeping/mopping, emptying trash cans and replacing liners, wiping down surface areas, clean-up spills and fluids, and ensuring general cleanliness and quality standards are met before the next event arrives. Perform maintenance as needed including changing lightbulbs, painting, light construction, repair, and more as assigned. Restock and reorder supplies as needed, manifest and report large scale repair needs and ensure the general upkeep of the venue from a maintenance perspective. Complete all assigned tasks within the guidelines & deadlines set by Supervisors and Event Manager. Inspect assigned work area prior to and during event, looking for safety hazards, facility issues, housekeeping needs, personal injuries, etc. Report issues to Supervisor or Event Manager. Required Qualifications A minimum education level of: High School Diploma or its equivalency A minimum of 1-2 years of related work experience Reliable, punctual, and regular in attendance Excellent interpersonal and communication skills Ability to take direction and work well with others Able to stand for extended periods of time (4-6 hours per shift) and lift tables, chairs, etc. Must be able to work flexible hours including nights, weekends, and holidays Employee must use precautions and follow safety guidelines Payscale: $20.00 Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Benefits: Part-time: This position may be eligible for benefits (ACA qualification). AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee’s job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description. AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants. We are an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any individual, employee, or application for employment on the basis of race, color, marital status, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other legally protected status recognized by federal, state or local law. Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

burklandassociates-burklandassociates:as.title: Controller
burklandassociates-burklandassociates:as.description: About Us Burkland’s core purpose is to Accelerate Dreams. So often, turning dreams into reality helps change the world. We thrive at the forefront of this transformation. Startups desire our professionals, they are the best in the business. Startups seek our content, we are an industry thought leader. Startups trust our expertise, so founders can focus on their companies, products, and value-add. As a part of our demonstrated value, our clients raised over $3B just last year. At Burkland, we lead with our Core Purpose. We do this for both our clients and our employees. We believe that leaning on our Core Values (Fresh Perspectives, Exponential Value, Empathy, Trusted Partner) will lead to happy clients and happy employees. We are a remote-first company with over 180 incredible team members, over 800 clients, and a commitment to Accelerating Dreams. The Role We are looking for a dynamic + strategic teammate at Burkland. If you have a background as a Controller and a passion for helping venture-backed startups succeed, Burkland is a wonderful fit for you! The Controller position is a hands-on role, responsible for implementing processes and systems for our clients - including mapping out needs, choosing a system, and setting up, and implementing the system. Your Typical, Atypical, Day - This role has variety at its core. From facilitating client meetings to overseeing monthly and yearly financial closes, no day will be a typical day (hence the typical, atypical day). - You will be supporting our startup clients who need Controller help but may not have a need for an internal team at their growth stage (usually we work with Seed through Series C clients). So, there is always a lot of work to be done! - You’ll be working with a variety of clients, so the ability to context shift, communicate, prioritize, and evaluate needs is the most important thing you’ll be doing in this role. - You’ll be managing accountants and processes for our clients and possibly internally to Burkland, too, so you’ll want to have a background in management - Embracing the agile and scrappy nature of startups is a must. About You - You are naturally curious and a problem-solver. You’re someone who likes to learn and is eager to take on new challenges, especially when it comes to cutting-edge technology and emerging industries. - You are a communicator at your core. Bonus points if you have customer or client service experience; this is a cornerstone of the role. - You lead with integrity in all that you say and do. - You take the initiative and jump at the opportunity to explore new ways of doing things. - You take an acutely accurate approach to your work and look forward to the parts of your job that require analytical thinking. - You are an expert collaborator! You ask for and give feedback regularly. - You’re pals with GAAP. - You have a Bachelor’s degree in business, accounting, finance, or something similar, and over 5 years of progressive experience. - CPA or CMA is a bonus. Core Competencies - Building and Overseeing Accounting Processes for Full Cycle Accounting - Financial Statement Analysis - Chart of Accounts Review and Recommendations - Cost of Goods Sold Guidance - Prior Client-Facing Experience - Preparation of Financial Statements, Reports and Presentations - Accounting for Intercompany Activity and Performing Financial Statement Consolidations - Accounting for Unrealized Gains and Losses - Familiarity with Equity Accounting and Reconciliations for Stock, and Convertible Notes - Advanced knowledge of ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition and ASC 842 - Lease Accounting - Experience Overseeing the Work Product of Others - Knowledge of the Financial Due Diligence Process What We Offer - Flexible work schedule to promote a healthy work-life balance. - Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance for you and your dependents. - Short & Long Term Disability Insurance to support you when you need it the most. - Flexible PTO - Take time off from work when you need it

jobgether-jobgether:lever:36b5a27d-9caf-.title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:36b5a27d-9caf-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in United States. This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community. You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization. The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes. You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations. The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones. You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences. Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement. Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion. Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement. Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features. Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance. Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification. Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture. Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments. Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality. Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment. Requirements Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x , including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android. Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers. Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider , as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation. Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies. Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups. Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage. Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices. Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes. Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team. Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills. Benefits Fully remote, full-time working opportunity. Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment beg

jobgether-jobgether:lever:582954e1-8bc6-.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:582954e1-8bc6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data & Analytics Engineer based in Ireland. As a Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of a modern data platform and business intelligence layer within a fully remote, international environment. You’ll help transform complex data into scalable, trusted, and actionable insights for both customers and internal teams. The role combines data engineering, analytics engineering, and data product ownership, giving you broad influence across the data ecosystem. You’ll modernise existing BI capabilities while building robust pipelines, semantic models, customer-facing analytics, and governance practices. Your work will directly support better decisions and measurable environmental and operational impact in the aviation industry. This is a high-autonomy role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, improving systems, and connecting technical solutions to real customer value. Take end-to-end ownership of the data platform, including Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, scalable pipelines, and lakehouse architecture. Design, build, and operate robust ETL/ELT workflows supporting batch and near-real-time data processing. Establish and maintain data quality, reliability, observability, performance, and architectural standards across the platform. Define data contracts, architecture principles, and modular, scalable approaches while optimising platform costs and workload distribution. Own Power BI semantic models, KPIs, dimensional models, DAX performance, aggregations, and dataset refresh processes. Build and maintain customer-facing dashboards, embedded analytics, and data exports while ensuring consistent and trusted metrics. Enable governed self-service analytics and support secure, scalable multi-tenant data models. Translate customer and business needs into scalable data products, define reporting standards with Product, and identify opportunities to create additional value through data. Implement testing, validation, monitoring, alerting, CI/CD, versioning, and other engineering practices across data pipelines and BI assets. Lead the transition from an existing vendor-built BI solution by reverse-engineering pipelines, logic, and reports, reducing technical debt, and rebuilding toward a clean, product-grade architecture. Proactively identify patterns, anomalies, optimisation opportunities, and new insights that can generate measurable customer and business impact. Requirements: 5+ years of experience in data engineering or analytics engineering, ideally focused on customer-facing BI products. Proven experience building scalable data platforms and customer-facing analytics in SaaS or product-driven environments. Strong hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Spark/PySpark and Delta Lake. Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or the broader Azure data ecosystem. Advanced Power BI expertise, including data modelling, DAX, performance optimisation, and semantic models. Advanced SQL skills and strong knowledge of dimensional modelling, particularly Kimball methodology. Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture, ETL/ELT design, multi-tenant data models, and embedded analytics. Experience implementing CI/CD for data pipelines and BI assets, as well as version control using tools such as Git. Strong engineering discipline, including writing reusable, modular, maintainable, and testable code. Experience with data quality, monitoring, validation, and testing practices. Knowledge of Azure infrastructure, including IAM and networking, is a plus. Familiarity with data quality frameworks such as Great Expectations is an advantage. Strong ownership and autonomy, with a focus on outcomes rather than simply completing assigned tasks. Product-oriented and impact-driven mindset, with the ability to connect technical data solutions to customer value. Proactive and pragmatic

jobgether-jobgether:lever:7ffac894-9521-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer – Users Infrastructure based in India. This is a high-impact backend engineering role focused on building the foundational identity and security infrastructure behind a global technology platform. As a founding member of the Users Infrastructure team in India, you will help shape a new regional engineering hub while contributing to a Tier-1 infrastructure function. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fbee17d9-2622-.title: Operations Supervisor
jobgether-jobgether:lever:fbee17d9-2622-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Operations Supervisor based in Ireland. This is a remote operations leadership role focused on scaling and maintaining a high-performing distributed workforce. You will work closely with the Operations Manager to translate broader objectives into effective day-to-day execution. Your focus will include workforce planning, attendance, quality assurance, coaching, onboarding, and operational administration. You will help grow the operation toward a target of 100 active agents while maintaining consistent performance and reliability. The role suits a hands-on operational leader who is comfortable managing people, monitoring performance, and addressing issues quickly. Strong organization, accountability, and attention to detail will be essential to keeping the operation running smoothly as it expands. Work closely with the Operations Manager to execute daily operational priorities and ensure activities remain aligned with broader business objectives. Manage and maintain an accurate roster of active agents, applying established policies to identify inactive agents and coordinate timely replacements. Monitor agent attendance and schedules to ensure team members consistently complete their required 8-hour daily shifts. Conduct daily test calls and quality checks to verify that agents meet established quality standards and operational expectations. Provide timely, constructive coaching and follow-up when quality issues, complaints, or performance concerns arise. Support workforce growth and capacity planning with the objective of building and maintaining a team of up to 100 active agents. Manage onboarding and compliance activities by reviewing required documentation, communicating status updates, and maintaining organized records. Calculate, prepare, and submit the operation’s monthly minutes-based invoice accurately and on time. Track operational performance, identify gaps, and take appropriate corrective action to maintain productivity, quality, and workforce stability. Requirements Demonstrated experience in operations, workforce management, team supervision, customer support, or a related operational environment. Strong ability to manage distributed or remote teams while maintaining accountability for attendance, productivity, and quality. Experience monitoring performance against defined standards and providing constructive coaching when issues arise. Strong organizational skills with the ability to maintain accurate rosters, schedules, documentation, and operational records. Comfortable working with spreadsheets, databases, operational tracking systems, and basic financial or invoicing information. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify discrepancies, follow established procedures, and maintain accurate records. Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with agents, managers, and clients. Proactive and hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues. Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating closely with operational leadership. Results-oriented mindset with a strong focus on team growth, quality, attendance, and consistent execution. Benefits Base salary: $200 per month. Performance-based bonus: 1% of the operation’s total gross monthly invoice. Bonus eligibility: The performance bonus becomes available once more than 20 active agents are maintained while completing their required 8-hour shifts. Growth-based earning potential: Compensation increases as the size and gross invoice value of the operation grows. Target earning example: At 100 active agents, the minimum gross monthly invoice is approximately $84,400, generating a minimum $844 performance bonus. Expected minimum monthly compensation at 100 active agents: $1,044, consisting of the $200 base salary

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:68027caf-84ac-464f.title: Data Analyst (Payments Team)
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:68027caf-84ac-464f.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Payment Data Analyst, щоб разом піднімати планку результату. 🎯 ЯКЩО ТОБІ ПОДОБАЄТЬСЯ ЗНАХОДИТИ ВІДПОВІДІ НА ПИТАННЯ, ЯКИХ ЩЕ НІХТО НЕ СТАВИВ, — МОЖЛИВО, МИ ШУКАЄМО САМЕ ТЕБЕ Ми не шукаємо людину, яка просто будує дашборди. Ми шукаємо аналітика, який допоможе зрозуміти, чому платежі працюють саме так, знаходити закономірності серед тисяч контекстів і разом із командою будувати продукт, який щодня проводить мільйони транзакцій. Це роль для людей, які люблять невідомість більше, ніж готові інструкції. Чим ти будеш займатися - Аналізувати платіжні процеси та знаходити закономірності в поведінці користувачів, мерчантів та еквайерів. - Досліджувати причини просадок у конверсії, збоях та інших ключових метриках. - Проєктувати та аналізувати A/B експерименти. - Будувати продуктові метрики та перевіряти гіпотези. - Разом із розробниками шукати, як зробити платіжний продукт швидшим, стабільнішим та ефективнішим. - Працювати з великою кількістю сирих даних, API, логів та технічних артефактів. - Знаходити відповіді навіть тоді, коли їх не можна отримати одним SQL-запитом. Виклики, які тебе чекають - Працювати в абсолютно новому напрямку, де багато задач ще не мають готових рішень. - Одночасно занурюватися у два продукти: платіжний шлюз і мерчанта, адже їхні метрики тісно пов'язані. - Розбиратися в особливостях десятків еквайерів, кожен із яких працює за власними правилами. - Постійно адаптуватися до нового контексту: команда розробки регулярно приносить нові технічні рішення, інтеграції та інсайти. - Будувати аналітику там, де правильну відповідь майже ніколи не можна отримати "в лоб". На що ти будеш впливати - Конверсію платіжних сценаріїв. - Якість інтеграцій із мерчантами та еквайерами. - Продуктові рішення, які безпосередньо впливають на мільйони платежів. - Пріоритезацію розробки та розвиток платіжної платформи. - Швидкість пошуку причин інцидентів та продуктових просадок. З ким ти будеш працювати У цій ролі твоїми основними партнерами будуть розробники. Тут значно менше класичної взаємодії з Product Manager і значно більше спільного розслідування, дискусій про технічну реалізацію, API, інтеграції та внутрішню логіку роботи платіжної системи. ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО - Впевнене володіння SQL. - Аналітичне та системне мислення. - Допитливість. Якщо щось не сходиться — ти не заспокоїшся, поки не зрозумієш чому. - Комфортно почуватися серед великої кількості нової інформації та швидко перемикатися між контекстами. - Любити дослідження більше, ніж готові відповіді. - Вміти ставити правильні питання й не боятися "задовбати" колег, якщо це допоможе знайти істину. Буде великим плюсом - Розуміння HTTP, REST API та принципів інтеграцій. - Досвід роботи з webhook'ами, логами або технічною документацією. - Досвід аналізу A/B тестів. - Розуміння платіжної індустрії, еквайрингу або процесингу. - Використання AI як інструменту для дослідження, аналізу документації та генерації гіпотез, а не як заміни власного мислення. Тобі буде комфортно, якщо ти... - любиш детективи більше, ніж покрокові інструкції; - після фрази "це дивно" відкриваєш SQL, а не закриваєш ноутбук; - можеш прочитати документацію, API, поговорити з розробником і тільки після цьог

We believe immigrants are the ultimate entrepreneurs — driven by relentless ambition and a vision for a better future for their families. Comun exists to serve them throughout their journey.
